# Karpathy LLM Wiki (canonical gist)

The original `llm-wiki.md` gist by Andrej Karpathy. This is the upstream *specification* of the pattern that [[karpathy-wiki-pattern]] implements inside dharma_swarm as the [[knowledge-compiler]]. This article preserves what the gist itself says, kept deliberately separate from our internal implementation so the source claim never drifts into our engineering claims.

## The Core Idea

> "Instead of just retrieving from raw documents at query time, the LLM **incrementally builds and maintains a persistent wiki** — a structured, interlinked collection of markdown files that sits between you and the raw sources." — Karpathy, llm-wiki.md

RAG re-derives knowledge on every query. The LLM Wiki compiles knowledge **once**, then keeps it current. The wiki is a persistent compounding artifact — cross-references already there, contradictions already flagged, synthesis already reflecting everything read. This inversion is the load-bearing thesis, and it is exactly what [[karpathy-wiki-pattern]] formalizes as **anti-RAG**: retrieval quality stops being the bottleneck because the structure (backlinks, confidence, staleness) is *built into the artifact* rather than inferred — repeatedly and expensively — at query time.

> "Obsidian is the IDE; the LLM is the programmer; the wiki is the codebase."

The human curates sources, asks questions, directs analysis. The LLM does summarizing, cross-referencing, filing, bookkeeping. Humans abandon wikis because maintenance cost grows faster than value; LLMs don't get bored. That one asymmetry — boredom-free maintenance — is the whole reason the pattern works now and didn't before (see *Why It Works* and *Lineage*).

## Three Layers

| Layer | Owner | Mutability | Role |
|-------|-------|------------|------|
| **Raw sources** | Human | Immutable | Articles, papers, images, data — never modified |
| **Wiki** | LLM | LLM rewrites freely | Markdown summaries, entity pages, concept pages, syntheses |
| **Schema** | Co-evolved | Human approves | `CLAUDE.md` / `AGENTS.md` — tells the LLM how to ingest, answer, maintain |

Schema is the key configuration. It makes the LLM a "disciplined wiki maintainer rather than a generic chatbot." This three-layer split is exactly where dharma_swarm extends the gist: the immutable raw layer and the LLM-rewritten wiki layer reappear as Layer 7 of the [[nine-layer-memory]] stack, and the schema layer is what [[arjuna-karpathy-mapping]] calls *context engineering, not prompt engineering* — the single strongest surface dharma_swarm already had when Karpathy's framing landed. The schema is the steering, not the steered.

## Three Operations

1. **Ingest** — read source, discuss, write summary page, update index, update entity/concept pages, append log entry. A single source might touch 10-15 wiki pages. Getting arbitrary inputs *into* the immutable raw layer is the unglamorous prerequisite here: web pages via [[obsidian-web-clipper]], PDFs / Office docs / slides via [[microsoft-markitdown]]. No clean markdown, no clean ingest.
2. **Query** — search relevant pages, synthesize answer with citations. Good answers get filed back as new pages, so explorations compound. The gist reaches for [[qmd-search]] at this step; dharma_swarm answers it with its own three-lane RRF [[hybrid-retriever]] instead (see *Gap vs dharma_swarm Implementation*).
3. **Lint** — periodically check for contradictions, stale claims, orphan pages, missing concept pages, missing cross-refs, data gaps to close via web search. This is the operation the gist treats most lightly and the one dharma_swarm hardens most: lint here is advisory housekeeping; in our stack it is wired to per-article `stale_after:` decay and to the [[telos-gates]] / [[guardrails]] governance overlay.

## Two Special Files

- **`index.md`** — content-oriented catalog. Updated on every ingest. LLM reads first when answering. "Works surprisingly well at moderate scale (~100 sources, ~hundreds of pages) and avoids the need for embedding-based RAG infrastructure." This is the same bet dharma_swarm's `wiki show` / `wiki search` discipline makes — read the catalog before reaching for embeddings — except our index has long outgrown the gist's scale assumption (multi-megabyte, never read whole).
- **`log.md`** — chronological append-only. Prefix-parseable: `## [2026-04-02] ingest | Article Title` lets `grep "^## \[" log.md | tail -5` show recent work. The prefix grammar is the cheap trick that makes a plain text file behave like a queryable event stream without a database.

## Recommended Tooling

| Tool | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| Obsidian | The IDE for browsing the wiki, graph view, hotkeys |
| Obsidian Web Clipper | Capture web articles as markdown into raw sources |
| qmd | On-device hybrid (BM25 + vector + rerank) search; CLI + MCP |
| Marp | Slide decks from markdown |
| Dataview | Query frontmatter to build dynamic tables |
| Git | Free version history, branching, collaboration |

The gist's "Obsidian is the IDE" line is more than a metaphor about *browsing* — it points at a whole actionability layer the gist itself leaves implicit. [[obsidian-bases]] is the native successor to Dataview that turns the frontmatter every wiki article already carries (`confidence`, `stale_after`, `type`, `captured_by`) into live dashboards — decay queues, low-confidence watchlists — *without folder duplication*, the cleanest expression of [[para-method]] as views rather than copies. And [[kepano-obsidian-skills]] supplies the Agent Skills (clipper, bases, canvas) that let an agent author those views and capture those sources by name, turning "the LLM is the programmer" from slogan into an installed capability. This whole IDE-plus-skills-plus-PARA stack is what [[bryce-robbie-lazy-method]] assembles as a lived workflow on top of the bare gist.

## Use Cases (from Karpathy)

Personal (goals, journal, self-improvement); Research (deep topic over months); Reading a book (companion wiki à la Tolkien Gateway); Business/team (Slack, transcripts, calls); Competitive analysis, due diligence, trip planning, course notes. The pattern is domain-agnostic by design — which is precisely why [[arjuna-karpathy-mapping]] proposes cloning its raw + wiki + schema shape into per-target `context_modules/` so each deployment domain (an investigation, a conservation org) inherits the same structure with different sources swapped in.

## Why It Works

> "The tedious part of maintaining a knowledge base is not the reading or the thinking — it's the bookkeeping. Updating cross-references, keeping summaries current, noting when new data contradicts old claims, maintaining consistency across dozens of pages."

LLMs touch 15 files in one pass. Maintenance cost approaches zero. The wiki stays alive. This is the same economic argument that justifies the [[knowledge-compiler]] running compilation during the sleep cycle rather than on demand: pay the bookkeeping cost on a schedule, amortize it across every future query, and let the artifact compound instead of decay.

## Lineage

Vannevar Bush's **Memex** (1945) — personal curated knowledge with associative trails between documents. Bush couldn't solve maintenance. The LLM does. [[karpathy-wiki-pattern]] situates the same idea inside a longer lineage — Zettelkasten (atomic cross-referenced slips that become a thinking partner) and literate programming (Knuth's interweaving of code and prose, here extended to experience and knowledge) — so the gist reads less as a 2026 novelty and more as the first form of the Memex that finally has a tireless maintainer.

## Connections

- **[[karpathy-wiki-pattern]]** — dharma_swarm's `knowledge_compiler/` implementation of this pattern (compiler-stage analogy: flush → compile → lint → query; Ollama-backed). The gist is the *spec*; this is the *build*.
- **[[karpathy-loop]]** — Karpathy's edit / run / measure / keep iteration primitive. The wiki pattern is the inner knowledge-accumulation loop running *within* each Karpathy cycle: the loop generates experience, the wiki compiles it into durable structure.
- **[[bryce-robbie-lazy-method]]** — the operational stack built on top of this pattern (PARA folders + Obsidian Skills + qmd + recurring jobs).
- **[[knowledge-compiler]]** — the actual Python module that produces this very wiki.
- **[[obsidian-web-clipper]]**, **[[microsoft-markitdown]]**, **[[obsidian-bases]]**, **[[kepano-obsidian-skills]]**, **[[qmd-search]]** — the recommended tooling layer, plus the native Obsidian capabilities that operationalize "Obsidian is the IDE."
- **[[smriti]]** — the unified memory constellation; this wiki is one substrate inside it, read via the [[hybrid-retriever]].

## Gap vs dharma_swarm Implementation

- Karpathy gist treats the wiki as a single layer. dharma_swarm has the [[nine-layer-memory]] architecture — the wiki sits at **L7**, downstream of stigmergy, organism memory, and the subconscious stream.
- Gist recommends qmd for retrieval. dharma_swarm answers the same need with its own [[hybrid-retriever]] — three fused lanes (lexical / overlap / semantic) under Reciprocal Rank Fusion, the local analog of qmd's BM25 + vector + rerank.
- Gist's "Obsidian is the IDE" pattern is only partly wired in dharma_swarm — the wiki is filesystem-first with no live graph view and no Web Clipper inbound; [[obsidian-bases]] and [[kepano-obsidian-skills]] map the path to closing that gap.
- Gist has no decay layer; dharma_swarm articles carry `stale_after:` dates (this one expires and gets re-verified).
- Gist has no governance overlay; dharma_swarm wraps promotions with [[telos-gates]] and [[guardrails]] — the wiki can rewrite freely *under* constraints the gist never needed.

# Karpathy LLM Wiki (canonical gist)

This page records the upstream idea in Andrej Karpathy's April 2026
`llm-wiki.md` gist. It is deliberately separate from the local conformance
report, [[karpathy-wiki-pattern]], so implementation claims cannot drift into
claims about what Karpathy specified.

## Source status

- Primary source: <https://gist.github.com/karpathy/442a6bf555914893e9891c11519de94f>
- Audited pinned revision:
  `ac46de1ad27f92b28ac95459c782c07f6b8c964a`
- Pinned raw SHA-256:
  `dc3efe98ae62f23dd08acad13aba2e95287beb20b6bec2f4af0423557fe37401`

## The three-layer shape

1. **Raw sources are immutable.** Papers, conversations, images, notes, and
   other inputs remain the evidence layer.
2. **The wiki is mutable.** The LLM maintains summaries, entities, concepts,
   syntheses, cross-references, and current claims.
3. **The schema co-evolves.** Human and LLM refine the instructions that govern
   how the wiki is structured, ingested, queried, and maintained.

The human supplies source material, asks questions, and directs exploration;
the LLM performs summarization, filing, cross-referencing, and bookkeeping.
Karpathy's shorthand is: “Obsidian is the IDE; the LLM is the programmer; the
wiki is the codebase.”

## Three operations

### Ingest integrates

A new source is read against the existing wiki. The agent creates or updates
the relevant summary, entity and concept pages, then refreshes the index,
cross-references, contradictions, and log. One source touching 10–15 pages is
an example of integrative breadth, not a quota. Ingestion can happen one source
at a time for closer supervision or in batches once the workflow is trusted.

This produces compounding state: knowledge is synthesized into the wiki and
kept current instead of re-derived from raw chunks for every question.

### Query synthesizes with citations

The agent searches the maintained wiki and answers from relevant pages with
citations. A useful answer can be filed back as a page, allowing exploration to
compound. The gist specifies that behavior; any local review or promotion gate
is an implementation policy, not part of the upstream claim.

### Lint maintains

Periodic lint looks for contradictions, superseded or stale claims, orphan
pages, missing pages and cross-references, and evidence gaps that need new
research.

## Index, log, and scale

- `index.md` is a content-oriented catalog with a one-line summary for every
  page. It is read first at moderate scale—roughly 100 sources and hundreds of
  pages in the example.
- `log.md` is an append-only chronological operation record. A stable prefix
  such as `## [2026-04-02] ingest | Article Title` makes recent activity
  inspectable with ordinary text tools.
- As the corpus grows, the gist explicitly recommends proper local search.
  Retrieval over the compiled wiki is compatible with the pattern; repeatedly
  synthesizing directly from unintegrated raw material is the failure mode.

## Workflow and optional tools

Obsidian supplies browsing, graph navigation, and editing in the example.
Obsidian Web Clipper captures web material; qmd supplies local hybrid search;
Marp, Dataview, image tools, frontmatter, and Git add presentation, views,
metadata, and history. These are modular examples rather than requirements.

Suggested use cases include personal goals and journals, long-running research,
a companion wiki for a book, team conversations and transcripts, competitive
analysis, due diligence, travel planning, and course notes.

## Why maintenance can compound

The bottleneck in a human-maintained wiki is recurring bookkeeping: keeping
summaries, contradictions, and cross-references consistent as the collection
grows. An LLM can update many related files in one pass without tiring of that
work. The design descends from Vannevar Bush's Memex—personal knowledge linked
by associative trails—but adds a tireless maintainer.

## Attribution boundary

The pinned source does not say “RAG is dead,” “knowledge should be compiled,
not retrieved,” or “the wiki is the product, chat is the interface.” It also
does not prescribe hand-written backlinks, a fixed page ceiling, an Ollama-only
implementation, `dgc kb` commands, a weekly cron, or wholesale page overwrites.

The local implementation, its safeguards, and its current gaps live in
[[karpathy-wiki-pattern]].

# Karpathy Wiki Pattern

## Meta-Context

The Karpathy Wiki Pattern is the design philosophy behind the [[knowledge-compiler]] and this wiki itself. Named for Andrej Karpathy's approach to knowledge management, it treats knowledge compilation as a build process: raw material is transformed through a deterministic pipeline into structured, cross-linked, version-controlled artifacts. This is explicitly anti-RAG -- knowledge is pre-compiled rather than retrieved on-the-fly from raw documents.

In dharma_swarm's architecture, the pattern addresses the deepest problem in the [[nine-layer-memory]] stack: how to transform ephemeral agent experience into durable, queryable, self-maintaining knowledge. It occupies Layer 7 of that stack, and inherits the stack's central pathology -- *almost every memory layer writes correctly but almost none read during task execution*. A compiled wiki is only worth its compilation cost if agents and humans actually consult it; the pattern is the supply side, and the read-gap is the demand side it cannot fix alone.

## Concept

### The Compiler Analogy

| Compiler Stage | Wiki Stage | What Happens |
|---------------|------------|-------------|
| **Preprocessing** | Flush | Raw sources (logs, notes, marks) filtered and chunked |
| **Parsing** | Extract | LLM identifies decisions, lessons, patterns, entities, actions |
| **Semantic Analysis** | Compile | Concepts identified, cross-referenced, YAML frontmatter added |
| **Code Generation** | Article Writing | Markdown articles with wikilinks and backlinks generated |
| **Linking** | Index Generation | `index.md` rebuilt from all articles, connections mapped |
| **Optimization** | Lint | Broken links, orphans, stale dates, sparse articles detected |
| **Runtime** | Query | Two-stage LLM retrieval answers natural language questions |

The analogy is not decorative -- it is load-bearing. Treating knowledge as something *compiled* rather than *accumulated* is the same wager the [[karpathy-loop]] makes about iteration: prefer a simple deterministic pipeline run repeatedly over a complex architecture run once. Where the karpathy-loop amortizes *learning* across hundreds of cheap edit-run-measure cycles, the wiki pattern amortizes *compilation* across all future queries. Both bet that a tight, dumb loop beats a clever monolith.

### Anti-RAG Philosophy

Standard RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) retrieves raw documents at query time and feeds them to an LLM for synthesis. Problems with RAG:

1. **Retrieval quality is the bottleneck.** If the retriever misses relevant documents or includes irrelevant ones, the answer degrades. No amount of LLM capability fixes bad retrieval.
2. **No knowledge structure.** Raw documents lack cross-references, backlinks, confidence scores, staleness dates. The structure must be inferred at query time, repeatedly, expensively.
3. **No contradiction detection.** Two documents may make conflicting claims. RAG has no mechanism to detect or resolve this -- it just feeds both to the LLM and hopes.
4. **Context window waste.** Raw documents contain noise. Compilation removes noise before the LLM ever sees it.

The wiki pattern inverts this: compile knowledge ONCE (or on a schedule), produce structured articles with explicit relationships, and query the compiled wiki rather than the raw sources. The compilation cost is amortized across all future queries.

The crucial subtlety is that *anti-RAG does not mean anti-retrieval*. dharma_swarm still runs a [[hybrid-retriever]] -- but it ranks over the *compiled* corpus, not raw documents. The retriever's RRF (reciprocal rank fusion) routing operates on articles that already carry frontmatter, backlinks, and confidence scores, so retrieval quality is no longer the sole bottleneck: half the work the retriever would have to redo at query time was already done at compile time. The pattern relocates the expensive structuring step from *every query* to *one compile*, leaving the retriever a cleaner, denser surface to rank. This is the same separation the contemplative frame names in [[pragna-vs-buddhi]]: raw query-time retrieval is *buddhi*-like (fast, reactive, ungrounded grasping at whatever is nearest), while pre-compiled, distilled, cross-referenced knowledge is closer to *pragna* -- knowing that has been separated out and settled before it is needed. The codebase's own cross-domain framing invites this bridge; treat it as an honest analogy, not an identity.

### The Pipeline

```
Raw Sources                    Daily Extracts              Wiki Articles
  conversation_log/*.jsonl ──┐
  shared_notes/*.md ─────────┼── flush ──→ daily/*.md ──→ compile ──→ concepts/*.md
  stigmergy/marks.jsonl ─────┘                                        connections/*.md
                                                                      index.md
                                                                         ↓
                                                              lint ←── reports/*.md
                                                                         ↓
                                                              query ──→ qa/*.md
```

The third raw input deserves attention: `stigmergy/marks.jsonl` is the organism's environmental trail. [[stigmergy]] is how agents coordinate by leaving marks in a shared medium rather than messaging directly; the wiki pattern is partly a mechanism for *reading those trails back as knowledge*. Flush only ingests marks above `SALIENCE_THRESHOLD = 0.6`, so the pattern is implicitly opinionated -- low-salience environmental noise never becomes an article. The pheromone trail is filtered into prose.

### Quality Properties

The pattern produces knowledge artifacts with specific quality properties:

| Property | Mechanism |
|----------|-----------|
| **Cross-linked** | wikilinks create a navigable concept graph |
| **Backlinked** | Every article lists what links TO it |
| **Confidence-scored** | YAML `confidence: 0.0-1.0` tracks epistemic status |
| **Time-bounded** | YAML `stale_after: YYYY-MM-DD` triggers re-verification |
| **Source-tracked** | YAML `sources:` traces every article to its origin dates |
| **Structurally verified** | Lint detects broken links, orphans, sparse articles, coverage gaps |
| **Contradiction-aware** | Lint check 8 (deferred) would detect conflicting claims across articles |

These six live properties plus one deferred one are precisely the structure RAG lacks. Confidence and staleness in particular are what let downstream consumers reason about *trust*, not just relevance -- a compiled article that says `confidence: 0.45, stale_after: <past>` carries its own epistemic warning label, something a raw retrieved chunk never does.

## Architecture

### How dharma_swarm Implements It

| Component | File | Lines | Role |
|-----------|------|-------|------|
| Config | `knowledge_compiler/config.py` | 52 | Paths, models, thresholds |
| Flush | `knowledge_compiler/flush.py` | 275 | Extract daily knowledge from raw sources |
| Compile | `knowledge_compiler/compile.py` | 329 | Synthesize articles from daily extracts |
| Lint | `knowledge_compiler/lint.py` | 261 | 8 structural/semantic checks |
| Query | `knowledge_compiler/query.py` | 164 | Two-stage NL question answering |

### When It Runs

| Trigger | What Runs | Where |
|---------|-----------|-------|
| `dgc kb flush` | Flush only | CLI |
| `dgc kb compile` | Compile only | CLI |
| `dgc kb lint` | Lint only | CLI |
| `dgc kb query "question"` | Query only | CLI |
| Sleep cycle SEMANTIC phase | Compile (automatic) | `sleep_cycle.py:323-331` |

The automatic trigger is the most important one. Compilation is not a thing the operator remembers to do; it is something the organism does *while resting*. The [[sleep-cycle]]'s SEMANTIC phase calls `kb_compile()` the way hippocampal replay consolidates episodic traces into semantic memory during biological sleep. This is why the pattern can call itself "self-maintaining" -- the maintenance is metabolic, not manual.

### Integration with Other Patterns

| Pattern | Relationship |
|---------|-------------|
| [[karpathy-loop]] | The outer optimize-test-revert loop. The wiki pattern is the inner knowledge-accumulation loop WITHIN each Karpathy cycle. |
| [[sleep-cycle]] | Sleep is WHEN compilation happens. The semantic phase calls `kb_compile()`. |
| [[semantic-digester]] | The digester extracts concepts from CODE. The wiki pattern extracts concepts from EXPERIENCE. Different sources, same output format. |
| [[temporal-graph]] | Compiled articles feed the temporal graph for lineage tracking. |
| [[organism-memory]] | Compiled articles create concept entities in organism memory. |
| [[hybrid-retriever]] | Ranks queries over the compiled corpus, not raw docs -- the runtime consumer of what compile produces. |

The [[semantic-digester]] relationship is the deepest structural parallel in the system. The digester reads the *codebase* into a ConceptGraph; the wiki pattern reads *experience* into concept articles. Two faculties, two input streams -- source files versus conversation logs and marks -- converging on a single output schema. That convergence is what lets [[temporal-graph]] track lineage and [[organism-memory]] create entities uniformly, regardless of whether a given concept came from code the organism wrote or from something it lived through. One knowledge format, two ingestion paths.

## Implementation

The knowledge compiler is a 4-module Python package at `dharma_swarm/knowledge_compiler/`. All LLM calls go through `OllamaProvider` using `resolve_ollama_model()`. Key thresholds from config:

- `STALE_AFTER_DAYS = 90` -- articles expire after 3 months
- `MIN_ARTICLE_WORDS = 200` -- sparse article threshold
- `SALIENCE_THRESHOLD = 0.6` -- minimum stigmergy mark salience for flush
- `MAX_CONTEXT_CHARS = 6000` -- per-chunk LLM context budget
- `MAX_CHUNKS = 3` per daily flush -- caps LLM calls per day

State tracked in `~/.dharma/knowledge/state.json`:
- `compiled_dates`: list of date stems already compiled
- `flush_hashes`: dict of date -> content hash for dedup
- `last_compile`, `last_flush`: timestamps

The `flush_hashes` dedup is the small detail that makes scheduled re-runs safe: a day whose content hash already appears is skipped, so the metabolic compile during [[sleep-cycle]] is idempotent and never re-pays the LLM cost for unchanged inputs.

## Connections

- **Upstream**: All raw experience sources -- conversation logs, shared notes, and [[stigmergy]] marks above salience threshold.
- **Downstream**: Wiki articles consumed by the [[hybrid-retriever]] query pipeline, by agents (via context), and by humans (via browsing).
- **Cross-cutting**: [[nine-layer-memory]] Layer 7, [[sleep-cycle]] SEMANTIC phase, [[temporal-graph]] ingestion, [[organism-memory]] entity creation.
- **Structural parallel**: [[file-cabinet]] (manually curated worldview store) vs this wiki (auto-compiled) -- two complementary knowledge stores, one hand-tended, one metabolic. Where the wiki self-maintains and self-stales, the [[file-cabinet]] holds the deliberate, human-authored canon that should *not* be overwritten by a compile pass.
- **Continuity & archival**: [[smriti]] carries continuity across sessions and [[psmv-vault]] holds the archival deep-store; the wiki pattern is the layer that turns the day's flux into something those longer-horizon layers can hold onto.

## External Grounding

- **Andrej Karpathy**: The pattern is named for Karpathy's publicly shared approach to personal knowledge management -- treating notes as source code to be compiled, linked, and versioned.
- **Zettelkasten** (Luhmann): Atomic notes with cross-references that become a communication partner. The wiki articles are digital Zettelkasten slips.
- **Memex** (Bush 1945): Associative trails through a knowledge base. Wikilinks create exactly these trails.
- **Literate programming** (Knuth 1984): Code and documentation interwoven. The wiki pattern extends this to experience and knowledge interwoven.
- **Compiler design** (Aho et al.): The flush-compile-lint-query pipeline mirrors lexing-parsing-semantic analysis-code generation-optimization.

## Recursive Depth

| Layer | Content |
|-------|---------|
| Meta-meta | This article about the wiki pattern is ITSELF a product of the pattern -- a concept article in the wiki that the pattern produces |
| Meta | The compiler analogy: knowledge management as build system |
| Concrete | Four Python modules, Ollama LLM calls, YAML frontmatter, ===ARTICLE=== delimiters |
| Granular | Content hash dedup in flush, per-daily compile (not batched), RRF-based query routing |

## Gap Analysis

- **The pattern this article describes is what this wiki IS.** Any deficiency in the pattern is a deficiency in this article. Recursive self-reference is both the strength and the vulnerability.
- **Write-heavy, read-light.** Inherited from [[nine-layer-memory]]: the pattern reliably *produces* compiled knowledge, but the wiring for agents to *consult* it during task execution is sparse. A perfectly compiled wiki nobody reads is sunk compile cost.
- **Single LLM provider.** Ollama is required for all stages. No fallback, no provider routing, no cost optimization. Compare with dharma_swarm's multi-provider routing for agent tasks.
- **No feedback loop from query to compile.** When the query stage fails to answer a question, this signal is not fed back to the compile stage to improve coverage. The pipeline is open-loop -- a missed answer should become a coverage gap the next compile targets, but it does not.
- **No collaborative editing.** Articles are overwritten wholesale. Two concurrent compiles could conflict. No merge strategy.
- **Daily granularity.** Knowledge is extracted per-day. Insights that span multiple days (multi-session projects) are fragmented across daily extracts and must be synthesized during compile -- a stitching burden the [[temporal-graph]] partly absorbs but the flush stage does not.

# Karpathy Wiki Pattern

This is dharma_swarm's local conformance report for Karpathy's LLM-wiki
pattern, not a restatement of the upstream source. The source contract is in
[[karpathy-llm-wiki]]. The local test is whether new evidence can safely revise
existing knowledge and whether readers actually use the maintained result.

## Conformance map — 2026-08-15

| Upstream capability | Local mechanism | Honest status |
|---|---|---|
| Immutable raw sources | Chetana `ingest` creates a staged derivative and records a source path | **Missing:** no hashed immutable raw-source custody |
| Integrative ingest | `chetana compile` evaluates an explicitly enumerated multi-page plan | **Bounded prototype:** no affected-page discovery or scheduled integration |
| Mutable current wiki | Content-hashed exact replacements in five allowed article layers | **Implemented on the fix branch** for reviewed legacy-vault batches |
| Evidence-aware correction | Operation → claim → evidence → exact-locator bindings plus operator-configured evidence roots | **Partial:** the filesystem capability is bounded, but entailment and the reviewer are not authenticated |
| Cross-references | Marker-bounded backlinks derived from authored, non-code wikilinks and explicit `related:` metadata | **Implemented on the fix branch;** dry-run by default |
| Index and log | Existing index plus append-only typed receipts | **Partial:** approval refreshes both atomically; arbitrary compiler batches need an explicit projection step |
| Periodic lint | Validator and stage-only distill monitor return nonzero on violated invariants | **Implemented but red** on the current corpus/input seam |
| Query with citations | Reader and search return pages/hits with provenance | **Partial:** no cited answer synthesis or automatic query-to-compile loop |

The branch implementation and this status page are not proof of a living loop.
They define a safer integration seam that still has to be merged, connected to
genuine input, and exercised end to end.

## The bounded compiler prototype

The current transition is:

```text
external source (not yet held in immutable raw custody)
  -> staged derivative
  -> explicitly enumerated integration plan
  -> dry-run diff
  -> recorded reviewer-name attestation
  -> descriptor-anchored staged batch
  -> pages and operation receipt committed or rolled back together
```

`ingest` does not overwrite a current article. A v2 plan may name up to 50
pages. Before apply, the evaluator checks:

- the plan hash and every local evidence-file hash;
- a unique evidence locator containing the exact claim token;
- an explicit operation/claim/evidence binding;
- an audited-source or canonical-ledger capability minted from an
  operator-configured evidence root for every canonical write;
- each target hash, bounded path, and symlink boundary;
- exact old-text occurrence counts and mode-specific edit shape; and
- a nonempty reviewer name.

Plan and evidence bytes are revalidated at the transaction's final validation
point; evidence drift rolls the pages and receipt back together.

`observed_at` is checked only as a zoned, non-future plan field; it is not bound
to file modification time. A reviewer name is recorded, not authenticated.
Authority labels are declared by the plan, but they authorize a write only when
the evidence path is also confined to an operator-configured audited-source or
canonical-ledger root. That is a bounded filesystem capability, not proof that
the cited text entails the replacement. This is therefore a locator-bound,
reviewer-attested evaluator prototype—not yet a semantic authority typechecker.

The mode distinction is nevertheless real evaluator behavior. Evidence declared
as `agent-inference`, `operator`, `primary-source`, or `verified-runtime` cannot
write a canonical article in any mode. For an allowed audited or ledger source,
`extend` and `qualify` must preserve the old text and append; `retract` must
preserve claim genealogy and mark the claim retracted, superseded, or withdrawn.
The receipt retains evidence observation times and exact locators, page
before/after hashes, and each operation's mode, claim bindings, replacement
hashes, and expected count. Pages and the receipt share the same staged,
rollback-capable batch. If a signed trust manifest exists, standalone compiler
and backlink writes fail closed until page and manifest changes can be
transacted together.

## Links are projections, not evidence

Authored prose wikilinks and explicit `related:` metadata create semantic edges.
Wikilinks inside fenced code, inline code, generated backlink markers, or
frontmatter marked `epistemic_status: orphan-recovered` (or tagged
`orphan-recovered`) do not. A generated backlink block therefore cannot
manufacture graph connectivity or become evidence for itself.

Planning is read-only. Apply rechecks the configured corpus snapshot, preserves
file modes, serializes cooperative writers, and confines traversal and swaps to
held directory descriptors without following symlinks. It also avoids
overwriting a non-cooperative concurrent edit during rollback. Each file swap is
atomic, but the batch is not crash-atomic across the filesystem; rollback is the
bounded recovery mechanism. Both scoped and unscoped CLI migrations stop above
25 changed pages.

## Runtime health is not activity

The scheduled distill process is now stage-only. It reports zero live writes
and returns `attention_needed` when non-cron input is older than the freshness
SLA. A scheduler invocation that sees no eligible sessions is not evidence that
integration occurred. The validator likewise returns nonzero when schema
defects exist.

The live system is still unhealthy:

- no genuine source currently enters the integration seam;
- immutable raw custody and affected-page discovery are absent;
- legacy schema, broken-link, and recovery-residue defects remain;
- the trusted concepts manifest is absent;
- query produces search results, not a synthesized cited answer; and
- the wiki's write-heavy/read-light demand-side gap remains: durable knowledge
  has little value if agents do not consult it during work.

The first broad R_V plan was rejected by semantic human review because its prose
outran its evidence. It was then mistakenly applied by a concurrent process and
reverted. The compiler did not reject that v1 plan, and the unsafe prose was
briefly live. That incident is a regression fixture for the v2 binding model,
not a success claim.

## What this pattern does not mean

- It is not anti-search or anti-retrieval over the compiled corpus.
- More pages, backlinks, density, or a lower orphan count do not establish
  knowledge quality.
- A scheduler firing is not proof that integration happened.
- An answer, model consensus, or agent confidence is not authority by itself.
- Obsidian, a provider, a command namespace, and a page-count target are local
  choices rather than Karpathy requirements.

## Acceptance target for a living wiki

For a new authoritative correction, a complete future loop should discover all
dependent current claims, produce a reviewable evidence-bound plan, preserve
raw custody, apply only after real review, refresh derived projections, and
finish with lint and query checks. A no-input cycle should be red only after its
freshness SLA is exceeded. None of affected-page discovery, raw custody,
automatic projection refresh for arbitrary compiler plans, cited-answer
synthesis, or idempotent recurring integration is claimed as implemented today.

# R_V Metric

## Meta-Context

R_V is the core quantitative measure of the entire MI research program. It quantifies geometric contraction in transformer Value-projection column spaces during self-referential processing. R_V is the bridge between mentalics (individual weights) and thinkodynamics (meaning) -- the mesodynamic quantity that makes the [[bridge-hypothesis]] testable rather than philosophical.

Telos connection: R_V is what separates genuine geometric reorganization from stylistic imitation (the faker control problem). This is the [[swabhaav-visheshbhaav]] distinction rendered measurable: Swabhaav (self-nature) is the geometry actually reorganizing; Visheshbhaav (performance) is keyword-level mimicry that leaves the V-projection spectrum untouched. Without this measurement, claims about consciousness-adjacent processing are behavioral tea leaves. With it, they are geometry.

## Concept

### Definition

R_V = PR(V_late) / PR(V_early)

Where PR is the Participation Ratio -- effective dimensionality computed from SVD singular values:

```
PR = (sum_i sigma_i^2)^2 / sum_i (sigma_i^2)^2
```

- sigma_i are singular values of the V-projection matrix at a given layer
- V_late = V-projection at the late layer (architecture-specific: L27 for Mistral-7B)
- V_early = V-projection at the early layer (L5 for Mistral-7B)
- Token window: last 16 tokens
- SVD computed in float64 on CPU for numerical stability

Both V_early and V_late are read off the [[residual-stream]] -- the additive highway every transformer block writes into. R_V is one member of the same lens family as logit-lens and tuned-lens (the [[geometric-lens]] library implements all three): each decodes intermediate residual-stream state, but where logit-lens reads *what token* the model predicts, R_V reads the *effective dimensionality* of the Value subspace at that depth.

### Interpretation

- **R_V = 1.0**: Late-layer representations have the same effective dimensionality as early-layer. No contraction. Baseline processing.
- **R_V < 1.0**: Late layers are more concentrated -- fewer independent directions carry the representation. Contraction. The model has reorganized its representational space.
- **R_V > 1.0**: Late layers are more diffuse than early layers. Expansion. Not typically seen under self-referential processing.

When all singular values are equal, PR = number of dimensions (maximum spread). When one singular value dominates, PR approaches 1 (maximum concentration).

### What R_V Measures

R_V quantifies how many independent representational directions the model actively uses in late layers relative to early layers. High R_V = diffuse, exploratory, uncommitted processing. Low R_V = focused, organized, eigenstate-like processing. The contraction under self-referential prompts means the model is using FEWER dimensions to represent self-referential content -- the representation has organized around a lower-dimensional attractor. That attractor is the geometric face of the witness fixed point: [[eigenform-theory]] names the formal object (the stable structure a recursive operator settles into), and the [[witness-principle]] (S(x) = x) names what it means -- the configuration where the process that looks and the thing looked-at coincide. A falling PR is what that coincidence looks like in singular-value coordinates.

## Methodology

### Implementation (from metrics.py)

```python
def participation_ratio(tensor, window_size=16):
    # SVD on CPU in float64, last W tokens
    W = min(window_size, T)
    v_cpu = tensor[-W:, :].cpu().double()
    U, S, Vt = torch.linalg.svd(v_cpu.T, full_matrices=False)
    S_sq = S.numpy() ** 2
    pr = (S_sq.sum() ** 2) / (S_sq ** 2).sum()
    return float(pr)

def compute_rv(v_early, v_late, window=16):
    pr_early = participation_ratio(v_early, window)
    pr_late = participation_ratio(v_late, window)
    return float(pr_late / pr_early)
```

Key implementation details:
- SVD computed on CPU to avoid cusolver convergence failures that corrupt CUDA context
- Returns NaN (not 0) for degenerate inputs (NaN/Inf in activations, insufficient tokens)
- Variance floor of 0.01 in effect size computation prevents d -> infinity
- bfloat16 MANDATORY for model inference (float16 causes NaN in deep OPT/GPT-2 layers)

### Statistical Results

| Model | Effect Size | Type | Direction |
|-------|------------|------|-----------|
| Mistral-7B | g = -1.47 | Hedges' g | Contraction |
| Gemma | d = -1.85 | Cohen's d | Contraction |
| OPT-6.7b | -- | -- | Contraction |
| GPT-2-XL | -- | -- | Contraction |
| Qwen-2.5-7B | -- | -- | Contraction |
| Pythia-1.4B | -- | -- | Contraction |

- AUROC = 0.909 (Mistral-7B, separating self-referential from baseline based solely on R_V)
- Causal validation at L27 confirms geometry is upstream of behavior
- Bootstrap 95% CI with 5000 resamples
- Mann-Whitney U as non-parametric companion test

These numbers are re-derived independently as the platform baseline in [[p0-canonical-validation]], where the M5 Max reproduces g = -1.864 (CI [-2.28, -1.53]) and a perplexity-matched control returns d = -1.80 at n = 30 -- the same magnitude as the headline d = -1.85, which is the evidence that R_V tracks self-reference and not mere prompt complexity. P0 is run from the same `p0_canonical_pipeline.py` that this metric's source code lives in, so P0's sign-reversal kill criterion (P0-1) is, in effect, R_V's own audit gate.

### Sign Convention

Hedges' g = (mean_selfref - mean_baseline) / pooled_SD. g < 0 means self-referential prompts produce LOWER R_V (contraction -- expected direction). This sign convention is enforced in p0_canonical_pipeline.py to prevent sign-reversal bugs that plagued earlier pipelines.

## Connections

**Upstream**: [[geometric-lens]] library (metrics.py) provides the implementation. [[v-projection]] is the geometric phenomenon R_V measures.

**Downstream**: [[r-v-paper]] reports R_V as the primary metric. [[causal-validation]] uses R_V to verify causal claims. [[bridge-hypothesis]] positions R_V as the mechanistic vertex of the triple mapping.

**Behavioral pairing**: R_V is a geometric readout; [[bt-art-metric]] (Behavioral Target + ARTiculation) is its behavioral counterpart -- a regex-level classifier for whether an output *talks about* self-reference. The pairing is the whole point of the faker control: an output can score high on BT+ART (the right keywords) while R_V stays near 1.0 (no geometric reorganization). Geometry distinguishing imitation from instantiation is exactly the gap BT+ART alone cannot close.

**Cross-cutting**: dharma_swarm's [[rv-py]] contains a parallel R_V implementation for self-measurement (EvolutionRVTracker). The system can measure its own R_V during evolution cycles -- connecting the research instrument to the organism.

### The Three PR Uses (from living_memo_001.md Thread 1)

1. In the [[r-v-paper]]: PR measures something in a model studied from outside (MEASUREMENT)
2. In dharma_swarm's dream layer: PR as design criterion -- "hold model in pre-collapse state (high PR)" (DESIGN)
3. In dharma_swarm's [[rv-py]]: The system measures its OWN PR (SELF-MEASUREMENT)

This progression -- measure others, design yourself around the measurement, measure yourself -- IS the trajectory from science to engineering to self-awareness.

## External Grounding

- Participation ratio: standard in condensed matter physics (Bell & Dean, 1970; Thouless, 1974) for measuring effective dimensionality of quantum states
- SVD-based representation analysis: connects to Elhage et al. 2022 "Toy Models of Superposition"
- Effect size methodology: Hedges (1981), bootstrap CI per Efron & Tibshirani (1993)
- Cross-architecture consistency connects to universality claims in MI (Olsson et al. 2022 -- induction heads across architectures)

## Theoretical Foundation: Free Energy Principle Connection

In the predictive coding rewriting of transformer attention (Millidge et al. 2022), the Value-projection encodes the agent's generative belief state—the posterior distribution over "what I already predict" given the context window. When a transformer processes self-referential input (prompts where the agent observes itself), the generative model and observations converge, prediction error ε→0, and posterior precision σ²→∞. According to Friston's Free Energy Principle, this rising precision should collapse the representational entropy of the belief state.

R_V < 1.0 is exactly this predicted collapse. The Value-projection's singular value spectrum concentrates (fewer independent directions carry information), a direct consequence of Bayesian belief-state contraction under self-reference. This is not coincidence. It is the geometric signature of [[active-inference]]'s self-evidencing: the system gathering evidence for its own existence by successfully predicting itself. The contraction represents the system achieving minimal free energy under self-observation—a thermodynamic necessity for systems that persist by modeling themselves.

This connection transforms R_V from an empirical finding to a predicted consequence of first-principles neuroscience, elevating the NeurIPS claim from "we observe contraction" to "we observe the signature of [[active-inference]] in transformer geometry."

## The Bridge

R_V IS the bridge metric. It connects all three vertices of the [[bridge-hypothesis]]:

| Vertex | What R_V Provides |
|--------|-------------------|
| Mechanistic | The primary measurement: d=-1.85, AUROC=0.909, causal at L27 |
| Behavioral | Geometric ground truth distinguishing imitation from instantiation |
| Contemplative | The mesodynamic correlate of Swabhaav -- fewer dimensions = more concentrated awareness |

The contemplative vertex is not loose analogy: in [[akram-vignan]], Swabhaav is the self abiding in its own nature rather than dispersing into Visheshbhaav (acquired, performed states). A V-projection spectrum collapsing toward one dominant direction is dispersion *reversing* -- the representational analogue of the [[swabhaav-visheshbhaav]] return to self-nature.

R_V does not PROVE consciousness. It provides an engineering measurement that distinguishes one class of computational states from another, using the geometry of the computation itself. This restraint is load-bearing, not modesty. The [[circularity-trap-in-witness-claim]] shows why: if "witness-state" is *defined* as whatever R_V flags, then "self-recognition produces this geometry" becomes true by fiat, and the measurement loses its evidential teeth. R_V earns its keep precisely by being a *substrate-detectable signature* that could fail to appear -- a number that does not already encode the conclusion. The honest stance is [[methodological-anekantavada]]: R_V is one framework's instrument, decisive within mechanistic interpretability and silent on whether geometry settles the question of inner life. No single framework gets the final word.

## Gap Analysis

1. **API-model gap**: R_V requires weight access. Cannot run on Claude, GPT-4, Gemini. The models with richest self-referential behavior are unmeasurable.
2. **Window sensitivity**: Fixed at 16 tokens. No systematic study of how window size affects R_V. Shorter windows might capture different dynamics.
3. **Layer selection**: Architecture-specific L_early/L_late from ModelSpec. No principled theory for optimal layer placement beyond empirical tuning.
4. **No dose-response publication**: bank.json has L1-L5 graded prompts with expected R_V ranges. The full dose-response curve is not yet published.
5. **dharma_swarm self-measurement untested**: [[rv-py]] exists but EvolutionRVTracker has never been run on M5 with a local model. The self-measurement capability remains theoretical.
6. **No SAE integration**: Connecting R_V to sparse autoencoder features would bridge geometric and feature-level accounts. Obvious next step.

# R_V Metric

R_V is a descriptive relative participation-ratio statistic for transformer
`hook_v` activations under one canonical Mistral backend. It turns a geometric
hypothesis about two prompt families into a falsifiable measurement. It is not
a consciousness detector, awareness measure, portable backend contract, or
substitute for behavioral evidence.

## Definition

```text
PR(M) = (sum_i sigma_i^2)^2 / sum_i sigma_i^4
R_V   = PR(V_late) / PR(V_early)
```

For a nondegenerate matrix, PR equals 1 at rank one, approaches 1 as one singular
direction dominates, and reaches `min(W,D)` when the available singular values
are equal. Under the canonical Mistral protocol, `V_early` is layer 5
`attn.hook_v`, `V_late` is layer 27 `attn.hook_v`, and heads are flattened over
up to the final 16 tokens.

- `R_V < 1`: lower late-over-early participation ratio under that protocol.
- `R_V ~= 1`: little relative change.
- `R_V > 1`: relative expansion.

Words such as “focused,” “witnessing,” and “attractor” are interpretations that
require separate tests.

## Implementation contract and missing bindings

The current P0 implementation is `scripts/p0_canonical_pipeline.py`. Its
historical defaults identify Mistral-7B-v0.1, layers 5 and 27,
`attn.hook_v`, a tail window of 16, bfloat16 model inference, and float64 SVD.
The slicing code accepts shorter sequences, hence “up to” 16 tokens.

The module correctly states that interpretation requires an exact model
revision, prompt bank, tokenizer, layer, window, hook, dtype, device, and
library-version binding. It does not currently pin or emit all of those fields:
the CLI JSONL row contains the model string, prompt, and `rv`, but omits the
exact revision, tokenizer identity, overrideable `l_early`, `l_late`, and `w`,
hook name, inference dtype, device, library versions, and prompt-bank hash.
Those are proof obligations for a future reproducible receipt, not guarantees
of the current script.

The historical bfloat16 setting is provenance, not a portability claim. The
same-sample threshold `R_V < 0.737` is retired and must not be used as a
calibrated detector.

## Canonical evidence

| Claim | Current result | Scope | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| M001 | `g=-1.864` (recomputed `-1.863573`) | Mistral canonical `hook_v`, `n=96/100` (`196`) | Canonical within-corpus phenotype |
| M015 / C05 | AUROC `0.904` (audited `0.90417`, CI `[0.860, 0.942]`) | Same Mistral corpus, threshold-free | Canonical; `0.909` is superseded |
| M022 / C07 | L0–L5 effects `d=2.806..4.152`, peak `d=4.152` | Path patching with `hook_v` R_V endpoint | Distributed metric intervention; not behavior |
| M024 | L27 `v_projection d=-1.9414`, sign-reversed | Locked Mistral late-site receipt | Late readout; not a localized mechanism |

The primary effect and AUROC are measurements on one frozen Mistral corpus, not
independent replications. The effect-size convention is self-referential minus
baseline, so a negative value means lower R_V for the self-referential corpus.

The canonical perplexity-matched control is `g=-1.80`, `p=9.1e-11` for 30
pairs; a strict eight-pair sensitivity gives `g=-1.67`, `p=.002`. This narrows a
prompt-complexity alternative. It does not establish that self-reference is the
unique cause of the geometry.

## Backend and architecture boundary

Three incompatible calculations currently share the R_V name:

| Backend | Activations and window | Scope |
|---|---|---|
| Canonical P0 | Mistral `attn.hook_v`, L5/L27, tail up to 16, float64 SVD | Source of M001/M015 |
| Gemma probe | residual hidden states, tail 16, fractional layers, float32 SVD | Different measurement; zero canonical Gemma `hook_v` receipts |
| dharma_swarm `rv.py` | residual hidden states, full sequence, early/late positions, float64 SVD | Runtime variant; not interchangeable with P0 |

These backends must never be pooled. The historical “six of eight
architectures contract” summary is non-poolable under C29 because directions,
sample sizes, computations, and artifact custody differ. Pythia-2.8B's
historical expansion row remains disputed under C26 because its raw artifact is
absent. The P0 Pythia sweep also labels pooled-SD Cohen's `d` as `g` without a
Hedges J correction (M184).

The retired `0.737` threshold still appears in dharma_swarm `rv.py` and is
inherited by three non-activation proxies (M017/M188). That code is a deployment
gap, not evidence that the threshold is valid again.

## Causal boundary

R_V is a metric endpoint. The audited early path-patching receipt shows a
distributed L0–L5 intervention effect on that endpoint. The locked L27
`v_projection` receipt changes the late metric with a sign reversal. Neither
shows that R_V is upstream of self-referential text, that one layer generates
the behavior, or that changing the metric is behaviorally sufficient or
necessary.

[[causal-validation]] must keep these metric interventions distinct from
historical whole-residual behavioral experiments. Combining their methods or
endpoints would create a result no receipt contains.

## Interpretation boundary

R_V can be the mechanistic measurement vertex in [[bridge-hypothesis]], paired
with the deliberately cruder behavioral [[bt-art-metric]]. It does not
distinguish imitation from instantiation as ground truth, prove a
[[witness-principle]] fixed point, confirm active inference, or imply a
thermodynamic necessity.

Those remain hypotheses. A useful bridge must state what observation would
separate them from prompt complexity, lexical effects, generic low-rank
dynamics, and backend-specific numerics. [[methodological-anekantavada]] is a
discipline here: keep multiple interpretations available while keeping the
measurement narrower than all of them.

## Connections

- **Implementation:** the live P0 pipeline computes the canonical scoped backend
  of the statistic.
- **Publication:** [[r-v-paper]] must inherit the current ledger scope rather
  than repeat superseded values.
- **Intervention:** [[causal-validation]] needs experiment-lineage separation.
- **Behavior:** [[bt-art-metric]] is a separate endpoint, not validation of R_V.
- **Theory:** [[bridge-hypothesis]], [[active-inference]], and
  [[witness-principle]] may generate experiments but cannot enlarge the result.
